source.original_text: For all natural d,q with 2q+1<d put r=q+1. On the original r independent standard d-dimensional Gaussian columns with product probability mu, let Phi_i be their actual physical row. Put theta_i=(i-1/2)pi/d, t_i=(1,sqrt(2)cos(theta_i),...,sqrt(2)cos(q theta_i)), and L=2r+3log(1000d). Define Yi=d^(-1)(Phi_i Phi_i-transpose tensor t_i t_i-transpose) on the inclusive event norm(Phi_i)^2<=L and zero otherwise. All matrix norms are real Euclidean operator norms and means are actual Bochner integrals under mu. The case q=0 is included. For every i and every sample omega, norm(Yi(omega))<=2rL/d. For every i, norm(integral Yi dmu)<=2r/d. This is the public Ex111 bound only.

decoder_context: Fin n is the finite index set of natural numbers less than n. Natural numbers embed into real numbers in the usual way.

EuclideanSpace real (Fin n) is real n-dimensional Euclidean space with its Euclidean norm and Borel structure. WithLp.toLp 2 wraps a coordinate function as that vector and WithLp.ofLp recovers its same coordinates.

stdGaussian on finite-dimensional real Euclidean space is the centered Gaussian probability law with identity covariance. Measure.pi is the finite product measure with its product measurable structure.
Real.log is the natural logarithm and Real.sqrt the nonnegative square root. The displayed less-than-or-equal branch includes equality.

Matrix.vecMulVec u v has entry u_i times v_j. Matrix.kronecker A B at row (i,j) and column (k,l) has entry A_(i,k) times B_(j,l). Scalar multiplication and subtraction have their ordinary real matrix meaning.
Every displayed matrix norm is the real Euclidean operator norm, namely the norm of its action between the Euclidean spaces on the displayed paired index set, not an entrywise or supremum norm.

Matrix expectations are Bochner integrals. This integral is totalized to zero when its integrand is not integrable; the displayed proposition must be reconstructed as written, without adding an integrability premise or assertion.

/-!
# Actual truncated Gaussian summand and mean norms

The literal original product experiment and closed cutoff are unchanged.
All moment, sign and operator-norm estimates are internal proof obligations.

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open scoped BigOperators Matrix Kronecker Matrix.Norms.L2Operator
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.FixedSpectrumSourceMatrixRadius

private theorem matrix_outer_norm {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ n) :
    ‖Matrix.vecMulVec u.ofLp u.ofLp‖ = ‖u‖ ^ 2 := by
  have he : Matrix.toEuclideanLin.symm
      (InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℝ u u : EuclideanSpace ℝ n →ₗ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ n) =
      Matrix.vecMulVec u.ofLp u.ofLp := by
    simpa only [star_trivial] using InnerProductSpace.symm_toEuclideanLin_rankOne u u
  have hl : Matrix.toEuclideanLin (Matrix.vecMulVec u.ofLp u.ofLp) =
      (InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℝ u u : EuclideanSpace ℝ n →ₗ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ n) := by
    rw [← he, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  have hc : Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := n) (𝕜 := ℝ) (Matrix.vecMulVec u.ofLp u.ofLp) =
      InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℝ u u := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro x
    exact congrArg (fun f : EuclideanSpace ℝ n →ₗ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ n => f x) hl
  rw [Matrix.cstar_norm_def, hc, InnerProductSpace.norm_rankOne, ← pow_two]

private theorem rankone_tensor_norm {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
    (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ m) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ n) :
    ‖Matrix.kronecker (Matrix.vecMulVec u.ofLp u.ofLp)
        (Matrix.vecMulVec v.ofLp v.ofLp)‖ = ‖u‖ ^ 2 * ‖v‖ ^ 2 := by
  let z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (m × n) := WithLp.toLp 2 (fun ij => u ij.1 * v ij.2)
  have hz : Matrix.kronecker (Matrix.vecMulVec u.ofLp u.ofLp)
      (Matrix.vecMulVec v.ofLp v.ofLp) = Matrix.vecMulVec z.ofLp z.ofLp := by
    ext i j
    dsimp [Matrix.kronecker, Matrix.kroneckerMap, Matrix.vecMulVec, z]
    ring
  rw [hz, matrix_outer_norm, EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq,
    EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  simp only [z, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs, mul_pow]
  rw [Finset.sum_mul_sum]

private theorem identity_rankone_norm {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] [Nonempty m] (v : n → ℝ) :
    ‖Matrix.kronecker (1 : Matrix m m ℝ) (Matrix.vecMulVec v v)‖ =
      ∑ j : n, (v j) ^ 2 := by
  classical
  let F : Matrix n n ℝ := Matrix.vecMulVec v v
  let K : Matrix (m × n) (m × n) ℝ := Matrix.kronecker (1 : Matrix m m ℝ) F
  let S : ℝ := ∑ j : n, (v j) ^ 2
  change ‖K‖ = S
  have hS : 0 ≤ S := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _)
  have hF : F * F = S • F := by
    ext j k
    change (∑ a : n, (v j * v a) * (v a * v k)) =
      (∑ a : n, (v a) ^ 2) * (v j * v k)
    rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro a _
    ring
  have hstar : K.conjTranspose = K := by
    dsimp only [K, Matrix.kronecker]
    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_kronecker, Matrix.conjTranspose_one]
    simp [F]
  have hKsq : K * K = S • K := by
    dsimp only [K, Matrix.kronecker]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_kronecker_mul, Matrix.one_mul, hF, Matrix.kronecker_smul]
  have hn : S * ‖K‖ = ‖K‖ * ‖K‖ := by
    have h := Matrix.l2_opNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self K
    rw [hstar, hKsq, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hS] at h
    exact h
  by_cases hv : v = 0
  · simp [K, F, S, hv]
  · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j : n, v j ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra! h
      exact hv (funext h)
    let i : m := Classical.choice inferInstance
    have hKne : K ≠ 0 := by
      intro hzero
      have hentry := congrArg
        (fun A : Matrix (m × n) (m × n) ℝ => A (i, j) (i, j)) hzero
      have hsq : v j * v j = 0 := by
        simpa [K, F, Matrix.kronecker, Matrix.vecMulVec] using hentry
      exact (mul_ne_zero hj hj) hsq
    have hnorm : ‖K‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hKne
    have hp : (‖K‖ - S) * ‖K‖ = 0 := by nlinarith [hn]
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hp with hs | hz
    · exact sub_eq_zero.mp hs
    · exact (hnorm hz).elim


theorem actual_source_truncated_matrix_norm_bounds
    {d q : ℕ} (hq : 2 * q + 1 < d) :
  let D := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)
  let E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (q + 1))
  let Ω := Fin (q + 1) → D
  let μ : Measure Ω := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (q + 1) => stdGaussian D)
  let r : ℝ := ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
  let L : ℝ := 2 * r + 3 * Real.log (1000 * (d : ℝ))
  let θ : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => ((i.val : ℝ) + 1 - 1 / 2) * Real.pi / (d : ℝ)
  let t : Fin d → Fin (q + 1) → ℝ := fun i k =>
    if k.val = 0 then 1 else Real.sqrt 2 * Real.cos ((k.val : ℝ) * θ i)
  let row : Fin d → Ω → E := fun i ω =>
    WithLp.toLp 2 (fun b : Fin (q + 1) => ω b i)
  let Y : Fin d → Ω →
      Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ := fun i ω =>
    if ‖row i ω‖ ^ 2 ≤ L then
      (d : ℝ)⁻¹ • Matrix.kronecker
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (WithLp.ofLp (row i ω)) (WithLp.ofLp (row i ω)))
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (t i) (t i))
    else 0
  (∀ i : Fin d, ∀ ω : Ω, ‖Y i ω‖ ≤ 2 * r * L / (d : ℝ)) ∧
    (∀ i : Fin d, ‖∫ ω, Y i ω ∂μ‖ ≤ 2 * r / (d : ℝ))
 := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  let D := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)
  let E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (q + 1))
  let Ω := Fin (q + 1) → D
  let μ : Measure Ω := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (q + 1) => stdGaussian D)
  let r : ℝ := ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
  let L : ℝ := 2 * r + 3 * Real.log (1000 * (d : ℝ))
  let θ : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => ((i.val : ℝ) + 1 - 1 / 2) * Real.pi / (d : ℝ)
  let t : Fin d → Fin (q + 1) → ℝ := fun i k =>
    if k.val = 0 then 1 else Real.sqrt 2 * Real.cos ((k.val : ℝ) * θ i)
  let row : Fin d → Ω → E := fun i ω =>
    WithLp.toLp 2 (fun b : Fin (q + 1) => ω b i)
  let Y : Fin d → Ω →
      Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ := fun i ω =>
    if ‖row i ω‖ ^ 2 ≤ L then
      (d : ℝ)⁻¹ • Matrix.kronecker
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (WithLp.ofLp (row i ω)) (WithLp.ofLp (row i ω)))
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (t i) (t i))
    else 0
  let S : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => ∑ k : Fin (q + 1), (t i k) ^ 2
  let F : Fin d → Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ :=
    fun i => Matrix.vecMulVec (t i) (t i)
  let K : Fin d → Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ :=
    fun i => Matrix.kronecker (1 : Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ) (F i)
  let a : ℝ := (∫ x : E, {y : E | ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ L}.indicator
    (fun y => ‖y‖ ^ 2) x ∂stdGaussian E) / r
  change (∀ i : Fin d, ∀ ω : Ω, ‖Y i ω‖ ≤ 2 * r * L / (d : ℝ)) ∧
    (∀ i : Fin d, ‖∫ ω, Y i ω ∂μ‖ ≤ 2 * r / (d : ℝ))
  have hd : (0 : ℝ) < (d : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < d by omega)
  have hr : 0 < r := by dsimp [r]; positivity
  have hscale : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 1000 * (d : ℝ) := by
    have hd2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (d : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (show 2 ≤ d by omega)
    linarith
  have hL : 0 ≤ L := by
    have hlog := Real.log_nonneg hscale
    dsimp only [L]
    linarith
  have hS0 (i : Fin d) : 0 ≤ S i := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _)
  have frame := FixedSpectrumCosineGram.actual_cosine_frame_gram (d := d) (q := q) hq
  have hS (i : Fin d) : S i ≤ 2 * r := by
    simpa only [S, t, θ, r, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, add_sub_assoc,
      show (1 : ℝ) - 1 / 2 = 1 / 2 by norm_num] using frame.2.2 i
  have hm := FixedSpectrumSourceMatrixMean.actual_source_truncated_matrix_means
    (d := d) (q := q) hq
  change (∀ i : Fin d, Integrable (Y i) μ) ∧
    (∀ i : Fin d, (∫ ω, Y i ω ∂μ) = (a / (d : ℝ)) • K i) at hm
  have moment := AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.StdGaussianMoment.integrable_norm_sq_and_integral_stdGaussian
    (E := E)
  have hgood : MeasurableSet {y : E | ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ L} :=
    measurableSet_le (by fun_prop) measurable_const
  have hret := moment.1.indicator hgood
  have hret0 : 0 ≤ ∫ x : E, {y : E | ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ L}.indicator
      (fun y => ‖y‖ ^ 2) x ∂stdGaussian E := by
    apply integral_nonneg
    intro x
    by_cases hx : ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ L
    · simpa [Set.indicator, hx] using sq_nonneg ‖x‖
    · simp [Set.indicator, hx]
  have hretle : (∫ x : E, {y : E | ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ L}.indicator
      (fun y => ‖y‖ ^ 2) x ∂stdGaussian E) ≤ r := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∫ x : E, ‖x‖ ^ 2 ∂stdGaussian E := by
        apply integral_mono hret moment.1
        intro x
        by_cases hx : ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ L
        · simp [Set.indicator, hx]
        · simpa [Set.indicator, hx] using sq_nonneg ‖x‖
      _ = r := by simpa [E, r] using moment.2
  have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := div_nonneg hret0 hr.le
  have ha1 : a ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hr).2 hretle
  have hK (i : Fin d) : ‖K i‖ = S i := identity_rankone_norm
    (m := Fin (q + 1)) (t i)
  constructor
  · intro i ω
    have htnorm : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (t i) : E)‖ ^ 2 = S i := by
      simp [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, S, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
    have hTensor : ‖Matrix.kronecker
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (row i ω).ofLp (row i ω).ofLp)
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (t i) (t i))‖ = ‖row i ω‖ ^ 2 * S i := by
      simpa only [WithLp.ofLp_toLp, htnorm] using
        rankone_tensor_norm (row i ω) (WithLp.toLp 2 (t i) : E)
    by_cases hx : ‖row i ω‖ ^ 2 ≤ L
    · dsimp only [Y]
      rw [if_pos hx, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hd.le), hTensor]
      calc
        _ ≤ (d : ℝ)⁻¹ * (L * (2 * r)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul hx (hS i) (hS0 i) hL)
            (inv_nonneg.mpr hd.le)
        _ = 2 * r * L / (d : ℝ) := by rw [div_eq_mul_inv]; ring
    · simp only [Y, if_neg hx, norm_zero]
      exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hr.le) hL) hd.le
  · intro i
    rw [hm.2 i, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg (div_nonneg ha0 hd.le), hK]
    calc
      _ ≤ (1 / (d : ℝ)) * (2 * r) :=
        mul_le_mul ((div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hd).2 ha1) (hS i) (hS0 i)
          (div_nonneg zero_le_one hd.le)
      _ = 2 * r / (d : ℝ) := by ring

end AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.FixedSpectrumSourceMatrixRadius

formulae.label: Actual Gaussian summand and mean operator norms
formulae.tex: \|Y_i(\omega)\|_{\rm op}\le\frac{2rL}{d},\qquad\|\mathbb E_\mu Y_i\|_{\rm op}\le\frac{2r}{d}\quad(1\le i\le d,\ \omega\in\Omega).

assumptions: Let \(d,q\in\mathbb N\) satisfy \(2q+1<d\), and put \(r=q+1\). This includes \(q=0\). Positivity of \(d,r\) and nonnegativity of \(L\) are derived internally.
Use the original space \(\Omega=(\mathbb R^d)^r\) with \(\mu=\gamma_d^{\otimes r}\), where \(\gamma_j=N(0,I_j)\). The physical row is \(\Phi_i(\omega)=(\omega_{1,i},\ldots,\omega_{r,i})\).
Put \(\theta_i=(i-\tfrac12)\pi/d\), \(t_i=(1,\sqrt2\cos\theta_i,\ldots,\sqrt2\cos(q\theta_i))\), and \(L=2r+3\log(1000d)\). Source index \(i\) is Lean index \(i.val+1\).
Define \(Y_i=d^{-1}(\Phi_i\Phi_i^\top\otimes t_it_i^\top)\mathbf1_{\{\|\Phi_i\|^2\le L\}}\). The cutoff is inclusive and row-specific. The Gaussian coordinate comes first in the paired matrix index.

Norms are the real Euclidean operator norm of the \(r^2\times r^2\) matrices. Expectations are actual Bochner integrals on the same original \(\mu\); the existing actual-mean theorem proves integrability internally.

The only proposition input is \(2q+1<d\). The feature bound, retained-moment coefficient \(0\le a\le1\), rank-one norm identities and actual mean estimate are proved inside the proof, with no certificate assumptions.

steps.title: Identify the actual Euclidean operator norms
steps.text: Identify a real outer-product matrix with its canonical Euclidean rank-one continuous map. Flatten the tensor of two outer products to the outer product of the paired vector. For an identity tensor feature outer product, use its symmetric square identity and a nonzero diagonal witness; the zero feature is handled separately. Nonemptiness needed by this generic identity holds automatically for the actual positive size r.

private theorem actual_source_centered_summand_radius
    {d q : ℕ} (hq : 2 * q + 1 < d) :
  let D := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)
  let E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (q + 1))
  let Ω := Fin (q + 1) → D
  let μ : Measure Ω := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (q + 1) => stdGaussian D)
  let r : ℝ := ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
  let L : ℝ := 2 * r + 3 * Real.log (1000 * (d : ℝ))
  let θ : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => ((i.val : ℝ) + 1 - 1 / 2) * Real.pi / (d : ℝ)
  let t : Fin d → Fin (q + 1) → ℝ := fun i k =>
    if k.val = 0 then 1 else Real.sqrt 2 * Real.cos ((k.val : ℝ) * θ i)
  let row : Fin d → Ω → E := fun i ω =>
    WithLp.toLp 2 (fun b : Fin (q + 1) => ω b i)
  let Y : Fin d → Ω →
      Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ := fun i ω =>
    if ‖row i ω‖ ^ 2 ≤ L then
      (d : ℝ)⁻¹ • Matrix.kronecker
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (WithLp.ofLp (row i ω)) (WithLp.ofLp (row i ω)))
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (t i) (t i))
    else 0
  let mean : Fin d → Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ :=
    fun i => ∫ ω, Y i ω ∂μ
  let Z : Fin d → Ω → Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ :=
    fun i ω => Y i ω - mean i
  let w : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => Real.cos (((2 * q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * θ i)
  let Rstar : ℝ := 2 * r * (L + 1) / (d : ℝ)
  (∀ i : Fin d, ∀ ω : Ω, ‖Z i ω‖ ≤ Rstar) ∧
    (∀ i : Fin d, ∀ ω : Ω, ‖w i • Z i ω‖ ≤ Rstar)
 := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  let D := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)
  let E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (q + 1))
  let Ω := Fin (q + 1) → D
  let μ : Measure Ω := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (q + 1) => stdGaussian D)
  let r : ℝ := ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
  let L : ℝ := 2 * r + 3 * Real.log (1000 * (d : ℝ))
  let θ : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => ((i.val : ℝ) + 1 - 1 / 2) * Real.pi / (d : ℝ)
  let t : Fin d → Fin (q + 1) → ℝ := fun i k =>
    if k.val = 0 then 1 else Real.sqrt 2 * Real.cos ((k.val : ℝ) * θ i)
  let row : Fin d → Ω → E := fun i ω =>
    WithLp.toLp 2 (fun b : Fin (q + 1) => ω b i)
  let Y : Fin d → Ω →
      Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ := fun i ω =>
    if ‖row i ω‖ ^ 2 ≤ L then
      (d : ℝ)⁻¹ • Matrix.kronecker
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (WithLp.ofLp (row i ω)) (WithLp.ofLp (row i ω)))
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (t i) (t i))
    else 0
  let mean : Fin d → Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ :=
    fun i => ∫ ω, Y i ω ∂μ
  let Z : Fin d → Ω → Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ :=
    fun i ω => Y i ω - mean i
  let w : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => Real.cos (((2 * q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * θ i)
  let Rstar : ℝ := 2 * r * (L + 1) / (d : ℝ)
  change (∀ i : Fin d, ∀ ω : Ω, ‖Z i ω‖ ≤ Rstar) ∧
    (∀ i : Fin d, ∀ ω : Ω, ‖w i • Z i ω‖ ≤ Rstar)
  have bounds := FixedSpectrumSourceMatrixRadius.actual_source_truncated_matrix_norm_bounds
    (d := d) (q := q) hq
  change (∀ i : Fin d, ∀ ω : Ω, ‖Y i ω‖ ≤ 2 * r * L / (d : ℝ)) ∧
    (∀ i : Fin d, ‖∫ ω, Y i ω ∂μ‖ ≤ 2 * r / (d : ℝ)) at bounds
  have hz (i : Fin d) (ω : Ω) : ‖Z i ω‖ ≤ Rstar := by
    dsimp only [Z, mean]
    calc
      ‖Y i ω - ∫ ω, Y i ω ∂μ‖ ≤ ‖Y i ω‖ + ‖∫ ω, Y i ω ∂μ‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
      _ ≤ 2 * r * L / (d : ℝ) + 2 * r / (d : ℝ) :=
        add_le_add (bounds.1 i ω) (bounds.2 i)
      _ = Rstar := by dsimp only [Rstar]; ring

reconstruction.text:
For every pair of natural numbers d and q such that 2q + 1 < d, set n = q + 1 and let r be the real number obtained by embedding n into the reals. Use Fin m = {0, ..., m - 1} as each coordinate index set. Define D = R^d and E = R^n with their Euclidean norms and Borel structures, Omega = (Fin n -> D) with its product measurable structure, and mu = the finite product, over b in Fin n, of the centered identity-covariance Gaussian probability law on D.

Define L = 2r + 3 log(1000d), where log is the natural logarithm and d in this expression is embedded into R. For i in Fin d, define
  theta_i = (i + 1 - 1/2) pi / d,
and, for k in Fin n, define the real coordinate function
  t_i(k) = 1                              if k = 0,
           sqrt(2) cos(k theta_i)         otherwise.
Here i and k appearing in real arithmetic denote their natural-number values embedded into R, and sqrt denotes the nonnegative square root.

For i in Fin d and omega in Omega, let x_i(omega) be the vector in E with coordinate x_i(omega)_b = omega(b)_i for every b in Fin n. Let I = Fin n x Fin n. Define a real matrix Y_i(omega) with row and column index set I by
  Y_i(omega) = d^(-1) [(x_i(omega) x_i(omega)^T) tensor (t_i t_i^T)]
                    if ||x_i(omega)||_2^2 <= L,
              0     otherwise.
The first branch includes equality. The outer products have their ordinary coordinate meaning, and tensor denotes the Kronecker product: for a,b,c,e in Fin n, the entry with row (a,b) and column (c,e) in the first branch is d^(-1) omega(a)_i omega(c)_i t_i(b) t_i(e).

The following conjunction holds:
  (1) For every i in Fin d and every omega in Omega,
        ||Y_i(omega)||_op <= 2rL/d.
  (2) For every i in Fin d,
        || integral_Omega Y_i(omega) dmu(omega) ||_op <= 2r/d.
Every displayed matrix norm is the real operator norm induced by the Euclidean norm on R^I. The row-vector norm in the truncation condition is the Euclidean norm on E. The integral is the totalized Bochner integral: it is assigned the zero matrix if the integrand is not integrable. No integrability premise or integrability conclusion is part of this assertion.
